name: Grammarly
tagline: AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, clarity, and generative drafting.
description: Grammarly checks grammar, spelling, clarity, and tone across the apps you already write in, and layers generative AI on top for drafting, rewriting, and tone adjustment. It works as a browser extension, desktop app, mobile keyboard, and web editor, with detection for plagiarism and AI-generated text on paid tiers.
insight: Its parent rebranded to Superhuman in Oct 2025 after buying Coda (2023) and the email app Superhuman; Grammarly is now a sub-brand.

modelSupport.notes: Generative features are metered by monthly AI prompts; free tier includes a limited prompt allowance.

edge: Runs system-wide across browsers, desktop, and mobile keyboards, so corrections follow you into any app.
pros: Plagiarism + AI-text detection on paid tiers
cons: Monthly AI prompt caps per tier
